en.headline: Two imported dengue cases recorded in the past week
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the patients had visited India and Bangladesh, bringing this year's total to 36 cases, mostly imported.
body: The Centre for Health Protection of the Department of Health announced on Friday that two imported dengue fever cases were recorded between 16 and 22 October. The patients had visited India and Bangladesh respectively during the incubation period.
Hong Kong has recorded 36 dengue fever cases so far this year, comprising 34 imported cases and two local cases. Last year the total was 59, all imported.

The Centre reminded travellers to take anti-mosquito precautions. Warm weather and occasional showers remain favourable for mosquito breeding even in autumn. No new chikungunya cases were recorded in the same week.

zh.headline: 過去一周新增兩宗外地傳入登革熱個案
zh.dek: 衛生防護中心表示，兩名病人分別到過印度及孟加拉國，今年累計36宗，大多為輸入個案。
body: 衛生署衛生防護中心周五公布，十月十六日至二十二日錄得兩宗外地傳入登革熱個案。病人於潛伏期內分別到過印度及孟加拉國。
本港今年累計錄得36宗登革熱個案，包括34宗外地傳入及兩宗本地感染。去年全年錄得59宗，全部屬外地傳入。
中心提醒外遊人士注意防蚊。雖然已入秋，但天氣尚未明顯轉涼，間中有雨，仍有利蚊子滋生。同期沒有新增基孔肯雅熱個案。
